status: current default; data-calibrated, expert prior pending

provenance.method: Pairwise logistic ranking fit on the simplex (weight floor 0.05, ridge lambda 0.1 toward equal weights), engine/score/weights/calibrate.py --floor 0.05; pre-declared in engine/score/weights/DECLARATIONS.md (A1 + amendment A1-1).
provenance.data: data/v2/cone_lit_benchmark_v1.csv (sha256 in results/calibration_floor05.json): 2573 within-paper, same-heat-flux pairs of formulations with different UL-94 class, 308 papers, 1511 rows.
provenance.result: Paper-grouped 5-fold CV x10: out-of-fold concordance 0.880 vs 0.861 for v0 and 0.874 for equal weights; beats v0 in 10/10 repeats; paper-bootstrap 95% CI of the gain over v0 [+0.002, +0.035]. Adoption rule met.
provenance.rounding: Full-data fit (TTI .102, pHRR .175, THR .081, avg_HRR .209, char .050, LOI .383) rounded to 0.01 so the weights sum to 1.
provenance.uncertainty: 5th-95th percentile of 500 paper-bootstrap refits; the lower ends sit on the 0.05 floor, so those bands are truncated, not tight.
provenance.caveats: Calibrated to UL-94, a small-flame test, which favours LOI (also small-flame). avg_HRR is present in both rows of only 165 pairs. Scores are comparable only at the same heat flux. Smoke is not an input. The patent (US 64/054,493) gives no numeric weights; these are Dravix choices.

expert_prior.how_to_apply: Export Google Form CSV -> python ahp.py responses.csv --out results/ahp_weights.json (check CR < 0.10) -> python calibrate.py --prior results/ahp_weights.json --floor 0.05 --out results/calibration_ahp.json -> adopt as v1.1 under the A1 rule; record both.
